name: O3b mPower 11-13
slot_a_text: 3 high-throughput communications satellites in Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) built by Boeing and operated by SES.
slot_b_text: Medium Earth orbit sits between the low satellites and the geostationary belt. It is where navigation constellations live, high enough that a handful of satellites cover the whole planet at once.
description: 3 high-throughput communications satellites in Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) built by Boeing and operated by SES.
rocket_fact: The 'Octaweb' engine arrangement is designed to protect surrounding engines if one Merlin engine explodes.
